name: Marta
price: Free during beta; paid license planned after beta (Patreon supporters with $15+ get a perpetual license)
summary: Native, keyboard-centric dual-pane file manager written in Swift, configured via a text DSL and extensible with Lua plugins. Opens many archive formats like folders; previews files via Quick Look.
where_it_wins: Lua plugin API and text-based configuration
Commander-style F-key workflow and Action Panel
Archive support incl. nested archives, ZIP read-write
Embedded terminal with directory sync, disk usage analysis
Look Up with rich Spotlight predicates
where_schnellbild_wins: Thumbnail grid with folder previews (Marta has list views only)
Real image and video viewer with slideshow

free.note: Free during beta; a paid license is announced for after beta ($15+ Patreon gives a perpetual license)

open_source.note: Closed source; only the issue tracker is public on GitHub

no_account_no_tracking.note: 'Marta doesn't collect or sell your data'

dark_light_setting.note: Five themes (light and dark), control style selectable regardless of the system

languages_20.note: English only; maintainer says a coming version will add localizations

thumbnail_grid.note: Only table and multi-column list modes; no thumbnails

recursive_search.note: Look Up (Spotlight index) globally or in the current folder

regex_search.note: Quick Select / quick search in the current list by regex; Look Up uses predicates

network_shares_fast.note: Open report: much slower than Finder on a NAS folder with many subfolders (~50 s vs ~10 s)

multiple_windows.note: As many windows and tabs as you want

img_modern_formats.note: Only Quick Look preview (Space); no own viewer or player

img_raw.note: Preview is the macOS Quick Look window (Space), no own viewer or player

img_psd_exr.note: Preview is the macOS Quick Look window (Space), no own viewer or player

img_svg_pdf.note: Preview is the macOS Quick Look window (Space), no own viewer or player

img_animated.note: Preview is the macOS Quick Look window (Space), no own viewer or player

keyboard_paging.note: Preview window updates when the cursor moves

zoom_rotate.note: Quick Look zoom only; full-screen image preview is an open request

slideshow.note: Not offered (open feature request for image browsing)

auto_enhance_view.note: No own image viewer; full-screen image viewing is an open request

file_info_exif.note: A file info panel (incl. image/media info) is an open, unimplemented request

wrong_extension_note.note: No file info view at all (open request #292)

video_mkv_avi_webm.note: Only what macOS Quick Look plays; which formats that covers is not stated in Marta's docs

video_skim_arrows.note: Depends on the macOS Quick Look player controls, which no source we read describes; Marta adds no player of its own (searched marta.sh docs and marta-issues)

subtitles_embedded.note: Depends on the macOS Quick Look player controls, which no source we read describes; Marta adds no player of its own (searched marta.sh docs and marta-issues)

subtitles_external_files.note: Preview is the macOS Quick Look window (Space), no own viewer or player; no way to attach subtitle files

audio_track_choice.note: Depends on the macOS Quick Look player controls, which no source we read describes; Marta adds no player of its own (searched marta.sh docs and marta-issues)

playback_speed.note: Depends on the macOS Quick Look player controls, which no source we read describes; Marta adds no player of its own (searched marta.sh docs and marta-issues)

control_bar_movable.note: Depends on the macOS Quick Look player controls, which no source we read describes; Marta adds no player of its own (searched marta.sh docs and marta-issues)

playlist.note: No player; a folder music player is an open request

saved_playlists.note: No player; a folder music player is an open request

pip.note: Depends on the macOS Quick Look player controls, which no source we read describes; Marta adds no player of its own (searched marta.sh docs and marta-issues)

music_mode.note: Quick Look plays a single audio file; a music player that continues through the folder is an open request

streaming_urls.note: Preview is the macOS Quick Look window (Space), no own viewer or player; local and mounted files only

online_subtitles.note: Preview is the macOS Quick Look window (Space), no own viewer or player

video_filters_enhance.note: Preview is the macOS Quick Look window (Space), no own viewer or player

quicklook_mkv_thumbnails.note: Shows no thumbnails at all (icon/thumbnail view is an open request); ships no Quick Look generator per its feature list

archives_as_folders.note: ZIP read-write; TAR, XAR, CAB, LZH, ISO, 7Z read-only; RAR only with limitations, RAR5 unsupported (open #290); nested archives

comics_cbz_cbr.note: No comic reader; extra ZIP extensions (e.g. cbz) can be registered in the config

archive_passwords.note: Open report: a password-protected 7z opens as empty; no password prompt

split_archives.note: Archive docs list all supported formats; multi-volume archives are not among them

videos_in_archives.note: Preview of files inside archives fails ('Preview can not be run in this context'), open request

manga_two_page.note: No own image or comic viewer

rename_trash.note: Shift+F6 rename, F8 trash, F7 new folder

move_copy.note: F5 copy, F6 move, to inactive pane

dual_pane.note: Dual pane with F5 copy, F6 move by default

undo_file_actions.note: Undo for file operations is an open feature request

image_editing.note: No own image viewer, let alone editing

batch_convert.note: Batch rename is an open feature request

library_catalog.note: Not even macOS tags can be set or shown as text; open requests

cloud_sync.note: No cloud file systems; maintainer points to third-party mounting tools

shortcut_cheatsheet.note: Docs list default hotkeys; no printable sheet

boss_key.note: No complete action list is published (Actions Panel only); searched marta.sh docs and marta-issues, nothing found

app_sandbox.note: Direct download outside the Mac App Store; maintainer discussed a sandboxed build (terminal would not work) but none is offered

mac_app_store.note: Direct download and Homebrew cask only
